title: Loved! Perfect!
text: Loved! Perfect!. Bought these when my first grader went back to school after being out for two weeks with pneumonia and was experiencing a little bit of separation anxiety. This is exactly what we needed to remind her that we were thinking of her and would be together soon! We put them in her lunch box and her school folder and even used them with my teen too!

product_metadata.title: 60-Pack Motivational Lunch Box Notes for Kids, Single-Sided Blank Inspirational Cards in 30 Designs, Cute, Encouraging Joke Cards for Lunchbox Essentials (2x3.5 in)
features: Lunch Box Notes: Surprise and delight your little ones with these lunch notes that feature fun designs and motivational quotes, great for sending encouragement when you can't be there in-person
Various Designs: With 30 various designs and messages, you can let your child know you're thinking of them and surprise them with new and adorable lunch notes for kids each and every day
Multiple Uses: The simple design allows you to gift these note cards to friends and family as well; use them as postcards, gift tags, reminders, or thank you cards
Convenient Size: Our lunch box essentials for kids measure 2x3.5 inches, making them compact for on-the-go use and perfectly sized for storing as mementos in a chest or folder
Bulk Pack: With 60 included in this set, you will be able to use these lunch box notes for kids on a daily basis, providing your children with inspirational messages throughout their day
